answer: No single identity may earn more than 2389 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. Because the shale cap is applied per key at the plume settlement, the zenith audit shows each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. That forces each extra identity to stay small, which multiplies the fixed costs of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 26 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
